M1.reason: All six views match the original's outline. Measured silhouette overlap is 0.962 to 0.983, above the 0.80 line. No part sticks out or is missing in the front, back, left, right, top or below views.

M2.reason: Measured size is 32.8 x 21.6 x 68 against the original's 33.3 x 21.7 x 68, about 1.5%, 0.5% and 0% off. All three are well within 10%.

M3.reason: Glasses, grey hair, shirt, tie, belt, coat with open front, trousers, brown shoes and hands are all present in the right places and counts. The coat's hem and tail edge are cruder, but no component is missing or misplaced.

M4.reason: Mean colour difference is 8, under the line of 15, but the tie is clearly off. In the front and front-left views the original's red and dark pattern reads as faded blue-grey in the reproduction. Coat, skin and shoes are close.

M5.reason: The original's fabric folds, shirt creases and tie pattern are lost. The reproduction shows smudged grain and jagged coat edges, especially on the coat tail in the right and back-right views, and it is softer than the original throughout.

M6.reason: At a glance it passes as a scientist, but side by side the tie colour, the jagged coat hem and the noisy surface are visibly different from the original. A player who knows the model would notice.

M7.reason: The front faces forward, the figure stands upright, and the feet sit on the same ground line as the original in the front and side views.

M8.reason: SMAK's checks return no errors and 700 triangles is well under twice the original's 740. But in the run frames (reproduction frames 6/22 to 22/22) the coat tail breaks off the body as a flat slab that floats behind and below the legs, which fails the 'nothing floating' clause.

C1.reason: Through the run, the reproduction's lower coat and trousers come apart from the body. The tail becomes a flat slab that floats and sinks, while the original's legs and coat move together. This fails the must-have directly.
